newsitem.title: CANADA: Toronto stocks lose more ground as golds tumble.
newsitem.headline: Toronto stocks lose more ground as golds tumble.

text.p: * Toronto stocks lost more ground at midday on Wednesday as the gold sector tumbled more than one percent. * 40.5 million shares trades worth C$634.5 million. * 11 of 14 sectors down.
Toronto stocks lost more ground at midday on Wednesday as the heavily weighed gold sector tumbled more than one percent.
The Toronto Stock Exchange's key 300 Composite Index fell 25.32 points to 6507.02 at midday in turnover of 40.5 million shares worth C$634.5 million.
Declining stocks outpaced advancers 454 to 292, while 312 issues were steady.
Eleven of Toronto's 14 sub-indexes were down, led by golds, which shed 124.67 points or 1.37 percent to 8956.54.
Consumer products, real estate and transportation gained ground.
